notes_for_human:
SPONSORSHIP (high-stakes field): the verbatim sentence recorded here is tier 2 (university career services carrying the firm's posting text), not tier 1, because every firm-hosted 2027 posting on jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com is JavaScript-rendered and returned no text. Two independent university career-services sites (Mercy University, Indiana University Kelley) carry byte-identical language, including the firm's own typo 'JPMorgan Chase, will not provide' and the misplaced parenthesis in '(CPT.)' — that identical-typo match is the reason for confidence that this is the firm's actual boilerplate rather than a paraphrase. It explicitly refuses OPT and CPT support. A rendering-capable fetch of the Oracle ATS is needed to promote this to tier 1.

MARKETS RESEARCH EXCEPTION NOT RECORDED: search snippets asserted the 2027 Markets Summer Analyst Program - Research offers limited sponsorship for STEM students, which would contradict the blanket no-sponsorship line. That page was unreadable, so nothing was recorded. This is the single highest-value follow-up: if true it is the only known sponsorship-eligible undergraduate route, and it must be read verbatim before publication.

PROGRAM RENAME: no live page for 'Advancing Black Pathways Fellowship' was found. The firm's current sophomore fellowship page is 'JPMorganChase Fellowship Program' at /programs/jpmcfellowship. ABP-named postings appear only in 2025-cycle archives. Treat ABP as likely renamed, not as a separate live program — but the rename itself is inference, not a firm statement, and is not recorded in any field.

APPLICATION CAP: the FAQ wording is 'We recommend you focus on no more than three summer internship program applications.' That is a recommendation. Do not publish it as an enforced cap. No stated per-cycle hard limit, no stated reapplication waiting period in months, and no stated video-interview retake duration were found anywhere on the firm's domain.

FELLOWSHIP COMPENSATION QUOTE IS TRUNCATED: 'The JPMorganChase Fellowship Program offers a five-week paid, full-time summer fellowship' is a contiguous verbatim substring that ends mid-sentence. It is accurate as far as it goes but should be re-pulled in full before publication.

SILENCE IS RECORDED AS SILENCE: Winning Women publishes no class year and no work-authorization sentence on the firm's domain; Code for Good publishes no work-authorization sentence; the Fellowship page publishes no work-authorization sentence. Third-party sites assert values for all three. None were adopted. Do not infer that these programs sponsor, or that they do not.
